I am an old woman of 68 years, and my strength is not what it used to be. This small plot of beans I keep near the house, intercropped as we always do, because beans feed the soil and feed my family. I cannot afford the chemical fertilizer from the shop — the prices are too high for a widow like me, and beans do not need it much anyway. I will put the manure from my few chickens and goats, use the seeds I saved from last harvest, and my daughter will come help me weed.
